summary.text: Incomplete Freedom Transformation is Reckless Savage Demon Venerable's combination killer move. Its three cores are Attitude, Mutation, and Adaptation.

claims.text: Fang Yuan had been fighting on the front lines. After he triggers Reckless Savage Demon Venerable’s method, a Reckless Savage voice tells him that the three monsters on the front lines come from three immortal moves created after reading Pursuing Freedom in The Legends of Ren Zu. Thunder rush yellow bird transformation uses attitude Gu as the core. Devouring blue leopard transformation uses mutation Gu as the core. Internal breathing green fish transformation uses adaptation Gu as the core. If all three can be triggered, they merge into one move. Reckless Savage’s solemn voice names that final combination incomplete freedom transformation, says it has numerous steps, and warns that the effect works on the body: failure means heavy injury at best, or death in severe cases.

A flippant Reckless Savage voice says a successful activation keeps human form while holding every advantage of the three moves with no weakness in any aspect, that the three monsters’ methods become innate abilities, and that the user immediately possesses quasi venerable battle strength and can suppress immemorial desolate plants and immemorial desolate beasts. Once the move activates, the three monsters combine into a bloody cape that hangs on the back. Reckless Savage’s own cape is a beast skin cape sewn from human skins; he says the three bloody skins combine into a bloody cape quite similar to the one he uses.

Fang Yuan finds the three killer moves and the combination not complex. He retreats and activates a killer move. The three monsters become yellow, blue, and green light rays, enter his body, merge into blood red light, and condense into a large blood red cape on his back. Allies and enemies conclude that he seems to have inherited Reckless Savage true inheritance.

Duke Long probes with spiraling dragon fangs. After the bloody cape forms, the fangs slash Fang Yuan’s body and leave sparks, with no marks or wounds. Combining the three monsters into incomplete freedom transformation requires Fang Yuan to transfer his own will. After the cape forms, that will becomes Reckless Savage’s will in Reckless Savage Demon Venerable’s image. The will can attend to the cape, help maintain the killer move, and quicken Fang Yuan’s understanding of it. The move consumes the three monsters’ foundation quickly and has a time limit. Fang Yuan then charges toward Heaven Overseeing Tower as a bloody ray.

Fang Yuan keeps a cold close-combat style in order to maximize the advantage of incomplete freedom transformation. With the three monsters’ strength, Duke Long is at a huge disadvantage in close combat, and Fang Yuan’s pressure on Heaven Overseeing Tower forces Duke Long to stay in that range.

Fang Yuan activates incomplete freedom transformation and combines the three monsters’ strength, but defense, movement, and healing are expended intensely. The move does not have much strength remaining. If it is stopped midway, he cannot use Reckless Savage Demon Venerable’s strength to activate it again. Next time he used it, Fang Yuan would have to rely on his own strength.

In Thieving Heaven’s true inheritance space, Fang Yuan opens his immortal aperture’s entrance and lets out rank eight transformation path Gu Immortal Zhan Bu Du. Immortal killer move Incomplete Freedom Transformation is named. The young man shouts, and a blood red cape appears on his back, fluttering with the wind. “I became handsome, I became stronger!” Zhan Bu Du clenches his fist and stares at Fairy Ming Hao and Fairy Yu Xiu.

Zhan Bu Du is one of Fang Yuan’s clones. He cultivates transformation path and has rank eight cultivation, but his own battle strength is still far from the peak of rank eight, and he is not the match of experts like Qin Ding Ling or Wu Yong. Once he uses incomplete freedom transformation, he instantly reaches pseudo venerable battle strength. The transformation is made up of internal breathing green fish transformation, devouring blue leopard transformation, and thunder rush yellow bird transformation. After he uses it, he gains the advantages of all three killer moves without any of their drawbacks: he can move like lightning, shoot out lightning bolts, possess immense recovery and regeneration, and devour all attacks. Fang Yuan gave incomplete freedom transformation to Zhan Bu Du. Fang Yuan is a pseudo venerable already, so using it himself would be wasteful; giving it to Zhan Bu Du produces another pseudo venerable instantly. Ming Hao and Yu Xiu do not dare to fight him head on. Killer moves that get close are either devoured or endured, then regeneration heals him completely.

On Book Mountain, Zhan Bu Du has already used incomplete freedom transformation, and his battle strength has risen to pseudo venerable level. A young man wearing a red cape stands on Ruan Dan’s back and beats it into the mountain.
Zhan Bu Du is using incomplete freedom transformation. He has genuine pseudo venerable battle strength, and Qing Chou cannot win.
Zhan Bu Du has incomplete freedom transformation. He is powerful and unstoppable, and he is the crucial battle strength for Fang Yuan’s side to ascend Book Mountain.

Zhan Bu Du wears the blood-red cape and moves like a flash of red lightning. A part of incomplete freedom transformation is thunder rush yellow bird transformation, a method that shoots yellow lightning, magnified several times in his hands. He roars, yellow lightning erupts, and the hair Duke Mei used to bind him is destroyed.
